name: Tsukushi Tsuma Yumi ~Ubawareta Aisai~
original_name: 尽くし妻由美～奪われた愛妻～
source:
The nameable protagonist and his wife Yumi are both 28 years of age and have a young boy and a baby daughter.
The protagonists runs a mountain climbing club but has someday a major accident because of to much sake and has to be transported with an helicopter to an hospital.
This is where the NTR Mystery starts as the insurence agency is witholding the insurance settlement and the young family is now indebted.

[Roughly edited from a netorare blog]
translation:
可命名的主人公和妻子由美都28岁，有一个年幼的儿子和一个女婴。主人公经营着一个登山俱乐部，但有一天因为喝太多酒发生了重大事故，不得不被直升机送往医院。NTR悬疑就此开始——保险公司扣留了保险赔偿金，这个年轻的家庭负债累累。

[粗编自一个NTR博客]
